name: Junyi Zhu

fitReason: Verified January 2025 Assistant Professor, suitable as a lower-physical-confidence embodied-sensing and spatial-interface backup. Detailed learned hand-pose estimation is established, but no robot action loop or current outside-master invitation is verified.

physicalEvidence.summary: Full CHI 2024 EITPose uses 48 impedance features with 100-tree ExtraTrees regression to predict 21 three-dimensional hand keypoints, plus a separate gesture classifier. The 22-person evaluation reports mean joint errors of 11.06 mm within session, 17.81 mm across sessions and 18.91 mm across users. This is learned wearable spatial sensing at prior institutions, not robotic actuation. The current lab also lists liquid-sensing gripper work, but its inspected abstract establishes sensing/data collection rather than closed-loop learned manipulation.
